name: tagly
description: Tagly monorepo — backend, mobile apps, shared SDK/models, and website
author: Flaer, Inc.

scripts.build: npm -w tagly-shared/models run build && npm -w tagly-shared/sdk run build && npm -w tagly-shared/client run build && npm -w backend run build
scripts.build:backend:runner: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn workspace @tagly/models build && yarn workspace @tagly/backend run build:runner
scripts.start:workers: concurrently -k --raw -n notifications,igInsights,igSnapshots,maintenance,cleanup,stripe,sharePayment "yarn start:worker:notifications" "yarn start:worker:igInsights" "yarn start:worker:igSnapshots" "yarn start:worker:maintenance" "yarn start:worker:cleanup" "yarn start:worker:stripe" "yarn start:worker:sharePayment"
scripts.start:workers:restart: concurrently -k --raw -n notifications,igInsights,igSnapshots,maintenance,cleanup,stripe,sharePayment "nodemon --watch tagly-backend/dist --ext js --signal SIGTERM tagly-backend/dist/workers/notifications/run.js" "nodemon --watch tagly-backend/dist --ext js --signal SIGTERM tagly-backend/dist/workers/igInsights/run.js" "nodemon --watch tagly-backend/dist --ext js --signal SIGTERM tagly-backend/dist/workers/igSnapshot/run.js" "nodemon --watch tagly-backend/dist --ext js --signal SIGTERM tagly-backend/dist/workers/maintenance/run.js" "nodemon --watch tagly-backend/dist --ext js --signal SIGTERM tagly-backend/dist/workers/cleanup/run.js" "nodemon --watch tagly-backend/dist --ext js --signal SIGTERM tagly-backend/dist/workers/stripe/run.js" "nodemon --watch tagly-backend/dist --ext js --signal SIGTERM tagly-backend/dist/workers/sharePayment/run.js"
scripts.clean:install: find . -maxdepth 2 -name node_modules -not -path './tagly-join/*' -not -path './tagly-website/*' -exec rm -rf {} + && rm -rf yarn.lock && yarn install
